summary: Iteration 10 — FULL frontend verification of the SoundMap complete redesign (Phase 1). All 8 features tested end-to-end with 100% pass rate. (1) AI Home '/' landing: `ai-home-question` renders '¿Qué querés hacer hoy?' with the SOUNDMAP CONSOLE whisper header and the 5 objective ghost cards inside `objective-picker` (objective-design/optimize/live/diagnose/report) — labels, hints and → chevrons all correct; click on `hero-cta-start` navigates to /design. (2) Hero Card empty state → `hero-state`='Sin proyecto activo', `hero-headline`='Diseñá tu primer sistema.', `hero-cta-start`='Empezar diseño' — PASS. (3) Hero Card demo state: clicking `objective-live` on empty state triggers loadDemoVenue() then navigates to /perform; returning to '/' shows `hero-state`='Sistema listo', `hero-headline`='The Warehouse Club', `hero-kpi-rt60`='RT60 2.67 s' and CTA morphs into `hero-cta-perform` (label 'Ir a Perform') — PASS. (4) Command Palette ⌘K: Ctrl+K opens `command-palette-overlay`, `palette-input` receives focus within ~150ms (the component has an 80ms setTimeout, so instant focus checks fail but the palette IS focused before user input arrives), `palette-results` list shows 5 correctly-labelled section headers ['Diseñar','Ejecutar','Analizar','Biblioteca','Ajustes'], filter='dsp' narrows to 2 items, Escape closes the overlay. All 6 required palette items present (`palette-item-design`, `palette-item-dsp`, `palette-item-kiosk`, `palette-item-live`, `palette-item-toolkit`, `palette-item-settings`). Click on `palette-item-toolkit` navigates to /toolkit. (5) AppShellV5 chrome on subpage: on /toolkit `shell-home` (link back to /) and `shell-cmd-btn` (top-right palette trigger) both present; mobile viewport (390x844) shows the floating `shell-mobile-cmd` pill at bottom-centre and clicking it opens the palette. NO legacy `sidebar-*` or `bottom-nav` testids appear on any of the 19 routes (verified by DOM scrape). (6) Full route regression across all 19 routes ('/', '/room-scan', '/gear-builder', '/pa', '/dsp', '/stage-map', '/channels', '/live', '/export-page', '/scenes', '/compare', '/community', '/templates', '/toolkit', '/settings', '/design', '/perform', '/analyze', '/library') — every route loads with the new AppShellV5 chrome, zero pageerrors, zero non-429/non-Vite-HMR console errors. (7) Specific regression preserved: /settings shows `replay-tour-btn`, /dsp shows `dsp-share-btn` (after demo seed), /stage-map shows `stage-optimizer-btn`. (8) /kiosk correctly renders fullscreen OUTSIDE AppShellV5 (`shell-home`=0, `shell-mobile-cmd`=0, `kiosk-root`=1). Note on 429 storm during dense navigation: when doing back-to-back gotos with <2s spacing Cloudflare returns 429 for static assets which breaks page rendering (blank screens & missing testids); with ≥8s spacing per iter_9 guidance everything is stable. Design impression: minimal Apple/Linear aesthetic is coherent — negative space intentional, desaturated accents (#C77A9E pink CTA, #4E9EA8 cyan RT60, #5BA777 green ready-state) render correctly against #09090b charcoal.
critical_code_review_comments: src/pages/ai-home/index.tsx L139: `{(hasRoom || true) && ...}` — the `|| true` short-circuits the guard and always renders the HeroCard. The intent (always render so the empty state is visible) is correct, but the `hasRoom || true` idiom is dead code; drop the guard entirely to `<motion.div ...><HeroCard/></motion.div>` for clarity, or remove the `hasRoom` reference from this line since it's meaningless.

src/components/soundmap/command-palette.tsx L82-97: the onKey useEffect depends on [open, items, activeIdx] — activeIdx changes on every ArrowUp/Down which re-registers a new keydown listener on every key press. Not a correctness bug (handlers still work), but consider using a ref for activeIdx or pulling the handler out of the dep chain (e.g., use a functional setActiveIdx and read items via ref) to reduce listener churn during rapid keyboard navigation.

src/components/soundmap/command-palette.tsx L99-113: the global ⌘K listener dispatches a `soundmap:openpalette` window event, but AIHome (which mounts its OWN CommandPalette instance) does not listen for that event — it only opens its palette via explicit button clicks. As a result, on '/' both the AppShellV5 palette AND the AIHome palette are mounted simultaneously (2 CommandPalette components), and pressing ⌘K on '/' opens the shell's palette while the AIHome-owned palette is dormant. Behaviour is correct today (only one opens at a time), but two mounted palettes is wasteful and the coupling is fragile. Recommend: (a) let AppShellV5 own the palette exclusively and remove the local `<CommandPalette>` from AIHome (pass `onCommandBarOpen` via the same window event), or (b) subscribe AIHome to the same event.

src/components/soundmap/hero-card.tsx L21-22: destructures 5 arrays (tops, subs, monitors, amps, dspUnits) from the store even though only .length is read — with the zustand store this triggers a re-render whenever any of those arrays' references change, even for unrelated fields. Use selectors: e.g., `const hasPa = useAppStore(s => s.tops.length + s.subs.length > 0)`. Non-blocking micro-perf.

src/App.tsx L61: `void SidebarNav; void BottomNav; void AdvisorWidget; void SyncIndicator; void ErrorBoundary;` — this silences unused-import warnings but also FALSELY marks ErrorBoundary and SyncIndicator as unused when they ARE used (both in AppShellV5). Remove them from the `void` line to keep the intent honest, or drop the whole line and eslint-disable specific imports.

src/pages/ai-home/index.tsx L11: `import { feedback } from '@/lib/feedback.ts'` — feedback('select') / feedback('tap') fires haptic + audio on every objective/CTA click, which is desired UX. However, primeAudio() runs on first pointerdown but the objective cards use whileHover motion that on some touch devices fires pointerdown differently — worth manual QA on iOS Safari to confirm the first `feedback('select')` actually plays sound (AudioContext must be resumed inside the same user gesture).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 8/8 features PASS. All 19 routes load with new shell chrome, 0 pageerrors, all required testids resolve, keyboard navigation & mobile pill both functional, legacy regression preserved (replay-tour-btn, dsp-share-btn, stage-optimizer-btn, kiosk fullscreen).

seed_data_creation: Clicked `objective-live` on '/' to auto-seed The Warehouse Club demo venue via useAppStore.loadDemoVenue() (needed for HeroCard in-progress/ready state and for /dsp `dsp-share-btn` to appear).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview: https://soundmap-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. Cloudflare 429 mitigation is CRITICAL — use ≥8s between page.goto() calls when doing dense route sweeps, otherwise static-asset 429s prevent React from mounting and testids appear missing (false negatives). AIHome mounts its OWN CommandPalette alongside AppShellV5's palette — pressing ⌘K on '/' opens the shell one. `palette-input` focus is deferred by an 80ms setTimeout — always `await page.wait_for_timeout(300)` after opening the palette before asserting document.activeElement. HeroCard empty-state renders unconditionally due to the `|| true` guard on line 139 of ai-home/index.tsx (see code-review). All 5 palette sections tested: Diseñar, Ejecutar, Analizar, Biblioteca, Ajustes (16 total commands as documented). No JS runtime errors observed on any of the 19 routes.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects. Phase 1 redesign implementation is functionally complete and preserves all legacy features. The 6 code-review comments above are polish/perf items, not blockers; the redesign passes UAT as-is.
